Looks like this function is not working with shortcut files, so i guess, `Move` menu item shouldn't be visible for shortcuts.

When pressing Move button app crashes.
By the way, to hide Move menu item for shortcuts, just use the next:
```cs
{
    Text = "BaseLayoutItemContextFlyoutMove/Text".GetLocalized(),
    Glyph = "\uE8B4",
    Command = commandsViewModel.MoveItemCommand,
    ShowItem = selectedItems.All(x => !x.IsShortcutItem)
},

```
Please, test app properly before requesting review.
Closing this PR due to inactivity.
